dispositions.PathBank:SMP0000785: Broader Biotin Metabolism map includes 16 direct reactions plus a fatty-acid pathway link. Complete canonical 14-step biotin biosynthesis is curated; BirA activation/ligation and broader FAS remain outside, not declared covered.
dispositions.GO:0009102: Biotin biosynthetic process is broader than this exact BioC/BioH route, so not used as pathway identity.
dispositions.MetaCyc:RXN-11474: Complete first condensation retained without assigned catalyst; ACP excludes old FabH proposal but exact FabB/F sufficiency unresolved.
dispositions.RHEA:34900: Legacy native BioC cross-reference retained as provenance only; current independently inspected UniProt/Rhea17105/17106 defines normalized chemistry. No exactMatch to legacy ID asserted.
dispositions.UniProtKB:P0AAI5: FabF investigated as possible redundant priming activity, not a declared catalyst.
dispositions.UniProtKB:P24182: False query hit from historical fabG synonym of accC; excluded.
dispositions.UniProtKB:P0A6A8: ACP gene product inspected as carrier context; whole modified ACP states remain native/Rhea classes rather than identical to unmodified accession.
